jd.title: Financial Controller
jd.external_text:
Marchwood Industries is a well-established group operating across several industrial sectors. Following a period of sustained growth we are seeking a Financial Controller to join our finance function at what is a genuinely exciting time for the business.

What you'll do
- Take ownership of the month-end close and the production of the management accounts.
- Business partner with operational stakeholders across the group.
- Support the annual budgeting and forecasting cycle.
- Maintain and strengthen the control environment.
- Assist with the year-end audit and liaise with our external advisors.
- Drive continuous improvement across finance processes and systems.

Requirements
- Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).
- Previous experience in a similar role within a multi-site business.
- Strong Excel skills and confidence with an ERP system.
- Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.
- Comfortable in a hands-on role within a lean finance function.

Nice to have
- Manufacturing or engineering sector background.
- Group consolidation experience.
- Exposure to a finance systems implementation.

What we offer
- Hybrid working following an initial settling-in period.
- A benefits package including car allowance, private medical cover and an enhanced pension.
- Reporting into the Group Finance Director, with genuine visibility at board level and a clear route to a Head of Finance seat.
